lines: Copy. Paste. Chase. Repeat. That's not the job you signed up for.
FansaChat turns one plain-English sentence into a complete workflow, across 700+ apps.
Freelancers: a client pays in Stripe, and the folder, contract and kickoff email are ready. A late Xero invoice? Reminders go out for you. A new Calendly booking? Already in your CRM.
Agencies: Meta ad leads go straight into HubSpot. Monday reports build themselves from Search Console. Every role gets its own flow. And client feedback in Figma reaches the right person on Slack.
Small businesses: bookings get text reminders, so fewer no-shows. Orders get delivery updates and a review request. Your own logins, and nothing runs until you approve it.
Clinics. Salons. Law firms. Online shops. Recruiters. Studios. Your workday, back.
